data.why: A chainsaw sits cut open on a garage driveway. The clutch is built up in front of the camera: a drum, three shoes, a ring spring, a brake band and a trigger, with a fence post to show the stakes. The camera opens mid on the saw, closes in on the clutch for each fix, and uses rpm gauges beside it for the numbers.

story.title: How a chainsaw clutch stops you from dying

ideas.idea: bolt the chain straight onto the engine shaft and you have a saw that can only ever spin
the engine never stops turning, so the chain whirls around the bar every second the saw is on
at about 50 mph that chain slices clean through a wooden post, so anything it touches is cut
hang the chain on a loose drum so the engine spins free inside it, though now the chain won't move at all
bolt heavy shoes to the shaft so that when it spins fast they fling out, grab the drum and drive the chain
a ring spring pulls the shoes back in so at idle they let go and the chain rests
this whole shoes-drum-spring assembly is called a centrifugal clutch
the ring that holds the shoes in is a garter spring
at idle the spring wins and the shoes stay in, but as the engine revs they fling out, grab the drum and the chain runs
a saw idles near 2,700 rpm but the shoes only grab at about 4,000, so the chain waits
if the bar tip catches, the saw kicks up toward your face with the chain still racing
a brake band round the drum clamps it when the hand guard knocks forward, and the chain stops in a blink
with the brake on and the engine still screaming, the shoes grind against the stopped drum and glow red hot
a spring-loaded trigger drops the engine back to idle the moment you let go, so the shoes pull in and cool
a stopped chain does not mean a stopped engine
the engine keeps turning at idle the whole time and only the clutch lets the chain rest
add a clutch cover, a front handle and a starter cord to complete the saw

surprises.claim: A running chainsaw chain moves at roughly 50 mph (about 80 km/h).
A chainsaw idles at about 2,700 rpm and its clutch only engages at about 4,000 rpm.
